items.headline: New commercial building permitted on Blossom Hill Road
items.summary: A permit for a new commercial building at 696 Blossom Hill Rd was issued with a construction valuation of $3,333,000. No unit count is listed, indicating a non-residential use for the site.

items.headline: Large solar and battery storage project permitted on Oakland Road
items.summary: A permit for a solar and battery installation at 1333 Oakland Rd was issued at a valuation of $2,509,654, pointing to a sizable energy storage system going in at that site.
